study_subtitle: Evaluate parcel repair, evidence interpretation and EUDR workflow
consent_points: Participation is voluntary and you may stop at any time.
The study records anonymous interaction events, task times and questionnaire responses.
Do not enter names, addresses or other directly identifying personal information.
Uploaded study geometries and decisions are stored for research analysis.

tasks.title: Explore a parcel
tasks.instruction: Open one parcel from Parcelas and inspect the map and validation information.

tasks.title: Make a validation decision
tasks.instruction: Review the evidence and confirm or reject the parcel boundary.

tasks.title: Review the activity queue
tasks.instruction: Open Actividad and inspect the least-confident item in the review queue.

tasks.title: Run the EUDR check
tasks.instruction: Confirm a parcel and complete its WHISP analysis.
